data.value:
Special values can be associated with certain colors.

With Add... you can create a new value-color pair. First enter the value (which must not exist) and then choose the associated color.

With Change... you can change the selected pair. You may change the value first or leave the field blank to indicate that you want to use your old value. Than choose the new color.

With Delete... all selected pairs are deleted. Warning: You will not be asked for confirmation!


With Default all existing pairs are deleted and values from 1 to 30 are inserted with a default color.

There are also keyboard shortcuts for Add and Delete: "Enter" and "Delete".
